title.narrative: The Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) secondments

description.narrative: Following the OECD council’s recognition of Ukraine as a prospective member, and its request to engage with Ukraine in an initial accession dialogue, OECD members have requested that the secretariat prepare a 4-year Country Programme for Ukraine. A country programme consists of reviews and other projects; OECD instruments to which Ukraine could adhere; and targets for enhancing Ukraine's participation status in OECD bodies. These are all benchmarks for reform. The Foreign Secretary committed to the UK funding 2 secondments to support this programme up to 2 years ( stated in Sep.2024 and was funded by GGF Ukraine 301455 during FY24-25).
